description: This Java class 'EmailTemplatesUtils' provides utility methods for generating and sending various email notifications within an e-commerce web application. It handles order confirmation emails, registration emails, contact form notifications, order status updates, download instructions, and password change alerts, leveraging template-based email rendering.

classes.name: EmailTemplatesUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to generate and send various transactional emails in an e-commerce application.

methods.name: sendOrderEmail
methods.description: Sends an order confirmation email to the customer, including billing/shipping details, order items, and totals.

methods.name: sendRegistrationEmail
methods.description: Sends a welcome/registration email to a new customer with access details and greeting.

methods.name: sendContactEmail
methods.description: Sends an email containing contact form details submitted by a user.

methods.name: sendUpdateOrderStatusEmail
methods.description: Notifies the customer of a change in order status with details and comments.

methods.name: sendOrderDownloadEmail
methods.description: Sends instructions and links for downloading digital orders.

methods.name: changePasswordNotificationEmail
methods.description: Sends a notification email to the customer after password change.
